title: Automated bacterial colony counting in macro-images
summary: My MSc thesis: enhancing plate photographs and training a detector on synthetic plates so colonies can be counted without hand-labelling thousands of images.

title: Synthetic-to-real colony image translation with CycleGAN
summary: Can a GAN make synthetic plates look real enough to train a better detector? I trained one on a memory-starved GPU server and report a negative result.

title: Fermentation kinetics of clavulanic acid production
summary: A tested Python package that fits logistic growth and Luedeking-Piret product kinetics to my BSc thesis data and asks when each Streptomyces clavuligerus strain makes its product.

title: Neural-network optimisation of fermentation conditions
summary: Reproducing a published ANN pipeline for fermentation optimisation in Python, including the data-splitting failure that taught me the most.

title: Does pretraining explain the gap? A ResNet50 ablation on OpenFungi
summary: A controlled comparison of a randomly initialised and an ImageNet-pretrained ResNet50 on fungal colony images, with three seeds and a paired test.

title: Predicting antimicrobial activity with graph neural networks
summary: Graph isomorphism networks trained on ChEMBL bioactivity data, evaluated with scaffold splitting so the model is tested on chemistry it has not seen.

title: BioprocessKit: a Python toolkit for everyday bioprocess analysis
summary: One toolkit and web app for the analyses every fermentation lab repeats: kinetics fitting, growth curves, design of experiments and batch analytics.

title: Genotype-phenotype maps under environmental change
summary: My research traineeship project in Nora Martin's group at the Centre for Genomic Regulation, Barcelona, starting January 2027.

title: Towards a hybrid digital twin of microbial fermentation
summary: The research direction I want to pursue in a PhD: mechanistic kinetics where the biology is understood, machine learning where it is not.
